routes.claim: Only an exact v2.9 held-audit item with a recomputed canonical artifact digest becomes typed-view vote-ready.
routes.passCondition: Exact fixture returns VERIFIED; malformed identity, altered payload, artifact digest drift, item digest drift, oversized input, or authority inflation returns HOLD and never vote-ready.
routes.primarySurface: focused renderer execution with exact and corrupt fixtures
routes.counterevidence: any mismatched claimed held-audit item renders as verified or vote-ready
routes.secondarySurface: live browser exact and mismatch selections

routes.claim: The typed view adds no submission or review authority and explicitly preserves the unresolved hold.
routes.passCondition: Source adds no post route; rendered view says hold unresolved and approval grants no action; contract fixes submission identity review decision hold resolution execution and promotion outside scope.
routes.counterevidence: the renderer submits votes claims identity resolves the hold or implies action authority

routes.claim: At desktop width a person can select a held audit and see its typed exact-digest decision context without losing raw evidence.
routes.passCondition: After one selection the typed VERIFIED panel full digest classification best action boundaries and raw JSON are visible without clipping or overlap.
routes.primarySurface: live browser baseline selection settled screenshot and semantic snapshot
routes.counterevidence: panel is missing misleading clipped overlapping or replaces raw evidence

routes.claim: A digest-mismatched claimed held audit visibly fails closed and cannot be voted from the UI.
routes.passCondition: Selecting the corrupt fixture shows a HOLD integrity panel and the vote button remains disabled after verification settles.
routes.primarySurface: live browser mismatch selection plus control-disabled semantic state
routes.counterevidence: mismatch appears verified or enables the vote control

routes.claim: The typed view remains readable at a narrow mobile-sized viewport.
routes.passCondition: At 390 by 844 the panel becomes one column with wrapped digests and no horizontal page overflow or sticky-panel collision.
routes.primarySurface: live browser narrow viewport screenshot and layout measurements
routes.counterevidence: horizontal scroll clipped evidence hidden controls or overlap

routes.claim: The additive renderer and minimal Review Inbox seams preserve inherited Workshop behavior.
routes.passCondition: Focused Review Inbox v2.9 inherited all ten AGENTS evidence and detached replay commands exit zero on stable inputs.
routes.counterevidence: any nonzero command or task-relevant moving-workspace conflict
routes.secondarySurface: final snapshot and clean detached replay
